description:
## Goal

Give ordinary conditionals and lazy `and`/`or` one ordered control-selection
authority. `if c, do: t, else: e` selects `e` for `false | nil` and `t`
otherwise. `a and b` returns `a` when falsey and lazily evaluates/returns `b`
otherwise; `a or b` returns `a` when truthy and lazily evaluates/returns `b`
otherwise. Interpreter, JIT and AOT must preserve the selected operand's exact
type, identity, ownership, effects and representation.

## Proven defects

Native logical `BinOp` lowering coerces both operands to truthy bits and returns
a boolean, while the interpreter returns the selected operand. It is eager and
loses list/container/callable identity.

Routing logical syntax through the parallel `ExprStep::If` / `LoweredTail::If`
pipeline exposes a deeper pre-existing contradiction. Semantic `If` ignores its
condition and analyzes both arms. In this baseline program the impossible
`false` arm reaches `callback.(2)`, earns `any`, and disagrees with the exact
settled closure result `int` when first-class callable demand activates the
public-call invariant:

```fz
offset = 40
callback = if false, do: false, else: fn(value) -> value + offset end
assert(callback.(2) == 42)
assert(callback === callback)
```

The same split pipeline also permits executable-local runtime demand and value
origins to retain structurally present but semantically unreachable arms.

Native Goto coercion has a separate SSA defect: it mutates the function-wide
value environment. Boxing a value for one edge can replace the binding later
read by a sibling block, producing a non-dominating use. The existing backend
interpreter likewise reads a delivered tail value before consulting the
successor layout, even when the authoritative layout proves no runtime value is
needed.

## Correct model

Source `if`, `and` and `or` lower through the existing ordered
`PatternDispatchPlan`. Evaluate the condition/left operand exactly once, then
use two ordered outcomes over that same `ValueId`:

1. a wildcard with typed precondition `false | nil` selects the falsey block;
2. an unrestricted wildcard selects the remaining truthy domain.

The mandatory miss is an unreachable Halt, never a semantic arm. For `if`, the
falsey block is `else` and the truthy block is `do`; for `and`, they are the
original left operand and lazy right block; for `or`, lazy right and original
left. Lower every source block once. Existing dispatch reachability refines the
same condition identity per ordered arm; existing Return/DeliveredResume joins
carry the selected value.

Delete `ExprStep::If`, `LoweredTail::If`, `BackendTail::If` and every parallel
planner, semantic, demand, origin, pruning, backend, interpreter, native,
canonical, keying and fixture consumer. Keep the low-level `fz_ir::Term::If`:
dispatch, guards and code generation still need CFG branches.

ActivationAnalysis is the sole executable reachability authority. Expose its
existing reachable-entry set to executable-local runtime-demand and origin
walks so they skip dead outcomes instead of recomputing truthiness. Preserve
the structural unspecialized body where function-level InputDemand genuinely
must describe both feasible inputs. Add no truthiness fact, condition registry,
second body, logical operator store, display-string dispatch or compatibility
path.

Native Goto emission coerces arguments at the edge into successor parameter
representations without rebinding source variables. Interpreter delivery passes
the optional source binding to the existing successor-layout decoder; only that
layout may accept an omitted value. Guard `and`/`or` use the same operand-return
semantics and lazy control in local and receive execution, while `.62` retains
ownership of GuardDispatch Value-or-Miss and typed intrinsic cutover.

## TDD signal

- RED then green the proven list reproduction on interpreter, JIT and AOT:
  `true and [1,2]` and `false or [1,2]` return the list, not `true`.
- Ordinary `if` and logical forms refine known `false`, `nil`, truthy and mixed
  domains. The captured-closure witness has exact closure identity/captures and
  its invocation result is `int`, including first-class identity demand.
- Both feasible arms retain their respective type, target, captures and input
  origins; a proven dead arm contributes no executable-local call, capture,
  product demand or value origin.
- Scalars, tuples, maps, lists and callables preserve selected identity and
  ownership. Selected lists remain retain-only when later rebuilt.
- The left operand executes once; an unselected raising, sending or other
  effectful right operand never executes. Nested and condition-only uses are
  lazy and return/control-correct.
- Function, case and receive guards return the selected intermediate operand,
  preserve ordered miss behavior and do not evaluate an untaken operand.
- Mixed-representation joins and the prior guard reproduction pass Cranelift
  dominance verification; sibling blocks never see edge-local coercions.
- Missing condition evidence waits; proven-empty evidence remains explicit
  bottom. Omitted `else` retains its source semantics. Selected and unselected
  divergence remain exact.
- Equivalent independent builds are byte-identical. An unchanged request starts
  no work and reuses retained backend/native allocations; an unrelated edit
  evaluates no requested-root product.

Run focused three-door and artifact/authority tests, full library and serial
fixture matrix, formatting, workspace all-target/all-feature check, strict
Clippy and diff-check. Remove temporary probes, duplicate tests and migration
scaffolding.

## Strategy and deletion

First pin semantic precision, ordered selection, dead-arm demand/origin,
ownership, effects and SSA failures. Add one shared source-control constructor
for the existing two-row dispatch plan and route ordinary `if` plus lazy
operators through it. Delete all three parallel If variants and their consumers
in the same cutover. Make executable-local consumers read existing settled
reachability. Finish the edge-local native coercion and successor-authoritative
interpreter delivery changes, then remove boolean-valued logical IR/codegen and
old truthiness/result duplication.

Update semantic-authority and control/pattern documentation to name ordered
dispatch as the one source conditional authority. One ticket, one commit, one
cold ticket-scoped adversarial review, one close.

## Ordering

This ticket blocks `.62`, whose lazy guard control uses the same correct
selected-operand joins, and `.60`, the final fidelity/reuse/debris proof. It does
not absorb `.117`'s independent callable-transport defect, `.154`'s interpreter
call-return-flow cutover, or `.62`'s quoted lexical identity work.
title: Collapse source conditionals onto ordered dispatch; return selected operands
